description: Remove the link between a user of an app and a row: the user stops being that row, and at once loses the rows of every relation endpoint they reached through it. The account, the row and the user's app access are not touched, and nothing is deleted. A user matched to the row by identityPhoneColumn or identityEmailColumn still reaches it; change the phone or email in the row to end that. Requires organization owner or admin. Removing a link that does not exist also answers success.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

itemId.description: Id of the linked row (itemId from list_app_user_links)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

userId.description: The user's id (userId from list_app_users), a UUID

name: unlink_app_user
